name: Political instability
value: No G20 collapse; Indonesia probe widens
summary: Indonesia names former police chief a suspect in the Prabowo wiretap case; no G20 government collapse
state: Indonesian police detained three police generals on 3 Nov over alleged tapping of President Prabowo's phone, and former national police chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo has been named a suspect (Jakarta Post; Indonesia Business Post). No G20 government had fallen and no coup or contested election had been reported as of 7 Nov.
for_you: No direct effect on most readers; travellers can check FCDO advice for the countries involved.
rubric_hit: No G20 collapse, contested election or coup = Normal

sources.title: The Jakarta Post — Three police generals named in plot to bug Prabowo
Indonesia Business Post — Former police chief Listyo named suspect

why: Coups, contested elections and constitutional crises in large economies unsettle markets, alliances and policy.
drivers: Elections, government collapses, coups, emergency rule, mass protest movements.

rubric.alert: Coup or constitutional crisis in a G20 country, or deadly unrest threatening a G20 government.
rubric.watch: Government collapse or contested election in a G20 country, or a coup anywhere.
rubric.normal: No G20 government collapse, contested election or coup in the past month.
